zh.l1: 工作的时候，消息总是从四面八方来。
zh.l2: 浮屿把它们收在屏幕顶上的一座小岛里。
zh.l3: QQ、微信、邮件，新消息一来，岛上直接看。
zh.l4: 点开邮件，不用切窗口，就能读完。
zh.l5: 看完，它自己收回去，桌面还是你的。
zh.l6: 浮屿，Windows 上的桌面灵动岛，开源免费。

en.l1: While you work, messages come at you from every direction.
en.l2: Fuyu gathers them into one small island at the top of your screen.
en.l3: QQ, WeChat, mail. When something new arrives, you read it right there.
en.l4: Open a mail, and finish it without switching windows.
en.l5: When you're done, it tucks itself away. The desktop stays yours.
en.l6: Fuyu. A dynamic island for the Windows desktop. Free and open source.
